source: Measured from live Notion Calendar DOM + screenshots (dark theme), 2026-10-14
priority: PRIMARY UI reference per user preference; Google Calendar is the feature reference
bodyFont: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
notes: Chips: tinted translucent background of the calendar color with SAME-HUE lighter text (e.g. olive bg + rgb(241,255,197) text), 3-4px radius, ~1px vertical gap, saturated 2-3px left edge on some chips.
Overall: dark #191919-ish canvas, extremely dense; hour labels tiny (10px) in a narrow left gutter.
Sidebar: mini-month at top, account email as section header, calendars with 10px color dots, eye icon to toggle visibility.
Top bar: view switcher dropdown (Week/Month) + Today button + chevrons, right-side panel with shortcuts/search.
Day headers: 'Sun 11' inline format; today's number in a red/accent rounded badge.
Month view: rows list '4 AM Sleep'-style time-prefixed entries with 'N more' overflow; weekend columns same width.
Right panel shows contextual shortcuts; command menu is Cmd+K.
Re-verify exact chip bg alphas by zooming screenshots during build; DOM climb hit column containers.
